gloss: in the blink of an eye, in no time

definitions.gloss: in the blink of an eye, in no time, before you know it
definitions.explanation: An expression describing something happening extremely quickly, so fast that one can only say "ah!" Literally: the interval of saying "ah."

examples.japanese: あっという{間|ま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: It was over in the blink of an eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あっという{間|ま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: The vacation was over before I knew it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}していたら→話す：00467_hanasu⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あっという{間|ま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: I was chatting with a friend I hadn't seen in a while, and time flew by in no time.

notes:
あっという{間|ま} literally means "the space/interval of saying 'ah!'" — so brief you barely have time to exclaim.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- あっという{間|ま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (in no time, ~): あっという{間|ま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧ (It was over in a flash)
- あっという{間|ま}だった (it went by in no time)
- あっという{間|ま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (fleeting ~): あっという{間|ま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧ (a fleeting event)

USAGE:
Nearly always used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Very common in everyday conversation and writing. Often expresses surprise at how quickly time has passed or an event occurred. Used for both positive and neutral situations (a fun time passing quickly, an event ending suddenly).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in an instant (slightly more formal)
- ⟦{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に→瞬く間に：21215_matatakumani⟧: in the blink of an eye (literary)
- ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: immediately, right away (neutral, no surprise nuance)
